gse244832.allowed_use: External-development unpaired mosaic robustness only. RNA and ATAC aliquots must be distinct modality batches, never one positionally paired MultiModalDataset.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 matrices, targets, preprocessing statistics, feature selection, query fitting, technical-category fitting, or calibration may enter a model scored on it.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only frozen cell-state inference after selection lock. It has no ATAC truth and cannot confirm MIDAS profile performance.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA features only; no labels, eQTL/ieQTL outcomes, optimization, feature changes, technical-category learning, or calibration before prediction hashes are committed.

gse296875.allowed_use: Same-nucleus RNA-ATAC outer-fold training and donor-held retrospective RNA-to-ATAC evaluation after activation gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define genes, peaks, chromosome chunks, masks, technical categories, configuration, parameters, early stopping, heads, or calibration. Held donors provide RNA only when the profile endpoint is scored.

local_model_roster.common_lane: frozen z_c RNA-only embedding with identical common head
local_model_roster.native_lane: frozen deterministic RNA-to-ATAC imputation and native biological latent, reported separately

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; place RNA and ATAC in distinct batches with distinct row identifiers
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; one paired batch only after exact ordered obs-ID validation
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA_only; omit ATAC rows structurally and preserve the explicit project state

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, nuclei, batches, and peaks are not independent biological replicates.
rules.feature_contract: Genes, peaks, chromosome chunks, transformations, masks, and output order are frozen inside the outer-training partition.
rules.held_query: Use a tensor-only project adapter with a prespecified training-known technical category and no optimization; the official loader alone is insufficient.
rules.no_false_pairing: Equal row counts are not proof of pairing. Same-batch modalities require identical ordered validated same-cell or same-nucleus IDs.
